title: BTS Closes North American Leg With SoFi Stadium Finale
detail: September 6, 2026 — BTS played the fourth and final Los Angeles show of the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg, closing out a 31-show run across 12 regions since April that drew an estimated 1.7 million fans with every stop sold out. The set ran the tour's standard 23-song rotation — including 'Run BTS,' 'WINGS 2,' 'Not Today,' 'Spring Day,' 'Dynamite,' 'IDOL,' 'FAKE LOVE,' 'MIC Drop,' and 'Fire' — closing out the Los Angeles stand that saw the city declare 'BTS Week' and light City Hall red in the group's honor. The tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2.

media.caption: BTS wraps the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with a SoFi Stadium finale.
